GOAL
Create `src/client/main.tsx` — the React SPA entrypoint — that exports an `App` component wrapping a wouter `Router` with the 8 routes from design §8 plus a catch-all 404 via a pathless `<Route path="*">`, an auth/session context fetching `GET /api/auth/me` once via the existing `useFetch` hook, guard components enforcing the member/owner/admin table, and a `Nav` component ported from `DESIGN/marketplace.html`; the module's import side effect mounts `App` into `#root` via `react-dom/client`. Pre-create 8 named placeholder page shells in `src/client/pages/` (one per route) so steps 40–48 fill them in place without touching `main.tsx`. Write two Playwright CT specs — `ct/nav.spec.tsx` (Nav in isolation: signed-out / signed-in-member / signed-in-admin variants, admin-only link, own `toHaveScreenshot` baseline) and `ct/main.spec.tsx` (full `App` from `main.tsx`: router reaches all 8 paths + 404, three guard redirects, light Nav-in-App assertions, `toHaveScreenshot` baseline) — both dual-runtime (playwright + bun:test fallback), all network mocked via `page.route`, with committed screenshot baselines.

The 8 routes, exactly as pinned in design §8 (path | page component | guard):
- `/login` → Login.tsx | public
- `/join/:token` → Join.tsx | public (valid token)
- `/` → Marketplace.tsx | member (authenticated)
- `/listing/:id` → ListingDetail.tsx | member
- `/new` → NewListing.tsx | member
- `/listing/:id/edit` → EditListing.tsx | owner (session user's `id` equals the listing's `seller_id`)
- `/me` → MyListings.tsx | member
- `/admin` → Admin.tsx | admin (session `role === 'admin'`)

CONSTRAINTS
- Do not modify any existing file's public surface: `src/client/api.ts` (`export const client = hc<AppType>('')`), `src/client/hooks.ts` (`useFetch`/`useMutation` signatures), `src/client/index.css` (`.nav`/`.nav-logo`/`.nav-links` classes already exist — reuse, don't restyle), `build.ts`, root `index.html`, `src/server/index.ts`, and every server route module [from: spec]
- All client↔server data flows through the existing `hc<AppType>` client in `src/client/api.ts`: no hand-written request/response interfaces, no `any`, no raw `fetch` with invented shapes; logout uses `c.api.auth.logout.$post(...)`, the owner check uses the typed `client.api.listings` parametric detail route [from: spec]
- Route paths and guard assignments match the §8 table verbatim: `/login`, `/join/:token`, `/`, `/listing/:id`, `/new`, `/listing/:id/edit`, `/me`, `/admin` — no adding, renaming, or re-nesting [from: spec]
- Do not implement the page bodies owned by steps 40–48 (no real login form, grid, gallery, uploader, admin table); only the router skeleton, guards, session context, Nav, and placeholder route children belong to this task [from: spec]
- wouter is pinned at 3.10.0: use `Router`, `Route`, `Link`, `useLocation` from `wouter`. There is no `<Switch>` or `<Redirect>` component in wouter 3.x — the 404 fallback is a `<Route path="*">` as the last child of `<Router>`, and guard redirects call the `navigate` function returned by `useLocation()` inside a `useEffect`. In CT tests, navigate via `history.pushState` (wouter monkey-patches it) — never `page.goto`, which reloads the CT gallery and invalidates `mount()` [from: spec]
- Code style passes the existing toolchain: Prettier `printWidth 120`, no semicolons, single quotes, `arrowParens: avoid`, 4-space indent; ESLint flat config (`no-explicit-any: error`, `no-shadow: error`, `react-hooks` on `src/client/**`); TypeScript strict (`noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noUnusedLocals/Parameters`, `verbatimModuleSyntax`); local `src/` imports use `.ts`/`.tsx` extensions while `ct/` specs import story modules without extensions [from: spec]
- Test-first cadence: both CT specs land in the same change as `main.tsx`, and the step is not done until `bun run test:ct` passes with the screenshot baselines committed [from: spec]
- The Nav uses wouter `<Link>` (not raw `<a href>` with `window.location`), and signed-out/signed-in state comes from the session context — one `GET /api/auth/me` per app mount, not per Nav render [from: spec]
- The CT specs mock all network calls at the `page.route('/api/**')` boundary (no live server, no DB) so baselines are stable; the config's `animations: 'disabled'` snapshot setting is already in place [from: spec]
- Both new specs follow the dual-runtime pattern: `import {test, expect} from '@playwright/experimental-ct-react'` at top, real tests inside `if (typeof Bun === 'undefined') {…}`, else `await import('bun:test')` with a trivial "discoverable" test — otherwise `AGENT=1 bun test` breaks [from: spec]
- `main.tsx` must be structured as an exported `App` component plus a separate `createRoot` side-effect mount; CT specs import `App`, never the side-effecting module (importing it would double-mount two `createRoot`s on the same `#root`) [from: spec]
- CT story modules that render styled UI import the prebuilt `../../dist/app.css` side-effect (CT Vite has no Tailwind plugin); unstyled test components may skip it, as `ct/HooksTest.tsx` does [from: spec]
- `Nav` gets its own `ct/nav.spec.tsx` (mounts `Nav.tsx` in isolation with `/api/auth/me` mocked for signed-out, signed-in-member, and signed-in-admin variants, asserts the admin-only link and the link set, captures its own `toHaveScreenshot` baseline), while `ct/main.spec.tsx` covers the full `App` — router reaching all 8 paths + the 404 fallback and the three guard redirects — with Nav-in-App assertions kept light there [from: Q1]

- While `GET /api/auth/me` is still loading, guarded routes render a loading state rather than a wrong redirect: a 401 settles as `error` with `data` undefined in `useFetch`, so the context must treat "not loading, no data" as signed-out or every anonymous page spins forever [from: spec]
- The `hc` inferred key for the parametric listings detail route is verified against the installed hono client types at implementation time (the research flags the leading-slash key uncertainty); `tsc --noEmit` enforces correctness either way [from: spec]
- `main.tsx` exports only `App` (plus the side-effect mount statement) to avoid `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings under the `src/client/**` ESLint block [from: spec]
